build.#: The tests import the Zena runtime, a development dependency, so its declarations must exist before tsc runs.

build:demo.#: The demo page's module: the counter and todo elements, built for the js target. Depends on `build` because the page loads this package's compiled JavaScript straight from the package root.

test.#: The server-rendering test runs `zena-cli` on `src/test/ssr/render.zena`, so it depends on the CLI build as well as on the language service module the other tests compile through; the linear-memory test loads the Rust example.

build:rust-example.#: The Rust element module, examples/rust, for the linear-memory extension's test. rustc's wasm32 target links through lld, which the dev shell provides.
